We do not offer direct exchanges, so the recipient would need to place a new order for the item they want and submit the original item for return here: https://vimhue.com/apps/returns. If the original order was delivered within 14 days, it is eligible for return. If Return Assurance by Loop was added at checkout, the return label is free. Otherwise, an $8 return shipping fee is deducted from the refund.
